title: SpaceTraders - Era Command
description: Single-screen command view of the current era: position (treasury, inventory at cost, hull counts, API cost), net performance over the selected window, and the trend lines behind it. Assembled from the live-validated panels in financial.json, trading-hulls.json and frontier.json (sp-iv3lt).

list.name: player
list.label: Player
list.description: Current era's player id, taken straight from MAX(id) so it re-points itself across an era rollover with no edit. Used to scope the Prometheus ledger panels the same way every SQL panel scopes itself. sort=4 (numeric desc) is deliberate: sp-ox2mj showed an unsorted player variable defaulting to the DEAD prior era during a Prometheus retention overlap.

list.name: smooth
list.label: Smoothing
list.description: rate() smoothing window applied to the 'Net P/L per Hour by Operation' panel - a larger window is a smoother, slower-moving line. The Operating Profit/hr panel keeps its own fixed 1h/3h/6h windows and ignores this.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval),
       AVG(balance_after) AS "treasury"
  FROM transactions
 WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
   AND player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Realised margin - LOT-MATCHED (the number to steer by; cash-flow panels below lag cargo in transit)
Realised Margin per Hour - LOT-MATCHED (the number to quote)
panels.description: Each purchase matched FIFO on (hull, good) to the sale that closed it, margin booked in the hour the position CLOSED. Identical to `spacetraders ledger positions --bucket 1h`. The naive line is the cash-flow series the panels above use (sells minus buys by the hour each leg landed): it books an hour of selling old inventory as profit and an hour of buying as loss, so it swings with leg placement, not economics. The last bucket is a partial hour.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cargo AS (
  SELECT t.created_at AS at, t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
         (t.metadata->>'units')::numeric AS units, t.transaction_type AS typ, ABS(t.amount)::numeric AS amount
    FROM transactions t
   WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> '' AND (t.metadata->>'units')::numeric > 0),
buys AS (
  SELECT hull, good, at, units, amount / units AS unit_cost,
         SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY hull, good ORDER BY at, amount) AS hi
    FROM cargo WHERE typ = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'),
sells AS (
  SELECT hull, good, at, units, amount AS revenue, amount / units AS unit_rev,
         SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY hull, good ORDER BY at, amount) AS hi
    FROM cargo WHERE typ = 'SELL_CARGO'),
matched AS (
  SELECT s.at, LEAST(s.hi, b.hi) - GREATEST(s.hi - s.units, b.hi - b.units) AS m,
         s.unit_rev - b.unit_cost AS spread
    FROM sells s JOIN buys b ON b.hull = s.hull AND b.good = s.good
     AND b.hi - b.units < s.hi AND b.hi > s.hi - s.units)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, 1h), 'lot-matched' AS metric, ROUND(SUM(m * spread))::bigint AS v
  FROM matched WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.created_at, 1h), 'naive (defective)' AS metric, ROUND(SUM(t.amount))::bigint AS v
  FROM transactions t
 WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
   AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> '' AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
 GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Lot-matched, last complete hour
panels.description: Realised margin of positions closed in the last complete clock hour (FIFO lot-matched). Ignores the time picker.

panels.title: Lot-matched, 24h average per hour
panels.description: Realised margin of positions closed in the trailing 24 hours, divided by 24. Ignores the time picker.

buys AS (
  SELECT hull, good, at, units, amount / units AS unit_cost,
         SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY hull, good ORDER BY at, amount) AS hi
    FROM cargo WHERE typ = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'),
sells AS (

         SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY hull, good ORDER BY at, amount) AS hi

panels.title: Margin per unit by bucket (thin filler shows here first)
Share of UNITS sold per hour, by realised margin per unit
panels.description: Every trade-hull sell in the hour, bucketed by realised margin per unit (sell price minus the hull's last buy price of that good). The red band is filler the solver planned at a near-zero spread: on 2026-09-03 it was 43% of units for -3.7% of credits before the 150/unit solver floor (trade_fleet.min_margin). Watch it: a growing red band means the floor is off or the markets thinned.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sl AS (
  SELECT l.realized_at AS at, l.realized_units AS u, (l.realized_unit_price - b.bpx) AS sp
    FROM tour_leg_telemetry l
    JOIN ships s ON s.player_id = $player AND s.ship_symbol = l.ship_symbol AND s.dedicated_fleet LIKE 'trade%'
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT b.realized_unit_price AS bpx FROM tour_leg_telemetry b
                   WHERE b.player_id = $player AND b.ship_symbol = l.ship_symbol AND b.good = l.good AND b.is_buy
                     AND b.realized_units > 0 AND b.realized_at < l.realized_at AND b.realized_at > l.realized_at - interval '3 hours'
                   ORDER BY b.realized_at DESC LIMIT 1) b ON true
   WHERE l.player_id = $player AND NOT l.is_buy AND l.realized_units > 0 AND $__timeFilter(l.realized_at)),
bk AS (
  SELECT at, u, sp,
         CASE WHEN sp < 50 THEN '1: under 50 (filler)' WHEN sp < 150 THEN '2: 50-150' WHEN sp < 400 THEN '3: 150-400'
              WHEN sp < 800 THEN '4: 400-800' ELSE '5: 800 and up' END AS bucket
    FROM sl)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, 1h), bucket AS metric,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(u) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(u)) OVER (PARTITION BY $__timeGroup(at, 1h)), 0), 1) AS v
  FROM bk GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Share of CREDITS earned per hour, by realised margin per unit
panels.description: Same buckets, weighted by credits. Healthy: the top two bands carry ~85% of credits and the red band is near zero or negative.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sl AS (
  SELECT l.realized_at AS at, l.realized_units AS u, (l.realized_unit_price - b.bpx) AS sp
    FROM tour_leg_telemetry l
    JOIN ships s ON s.player_id = $player AND s.ship_symbol = l.ship_symbol AND s.dedicated_fleet LIKE 'trade%'
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT b.realized_unit_price AS bpx FROM tour_leg_telemetry b
                   WHERE b.player_id = $player AND b.ship_symbol = l.ship_symbol AND b.good = l.good AND b.is_buy
                     AND b.realized_units > 0 AND b.realized_at < l.realized_at AND b.realized_at > l.realized_at - interval '3 hours'
                   ORDER BY b.realized_at DESC LIMIT 1) b ON true
   WHERE l.player_id = $player AND NOT l.is_buy AND l.realized_units > 0 AND $__timeFilter(l.realized_at)),
bk AS (
  SELECT at, u, sp,
         CASE WHEN sp < 50 THEN '1: under 50 (filler)' WHEN sp < 150 THEN '2: 50-150' WHEN sp < 400 THEN '3: 150-400'
              WHEN sp < 800 THEN '4: 400-800' ELSE '5: 800 and up' END AS bucket
    FROM sl)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, 1h), bucket AS metric,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(u * sp) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(u * sp)) OVER (PARTITION BY $__timeGroup(at, 1h)), 0), 1) AS v
  FROM bk GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Last complete hour: thin share, margin/unit, thin net
panels.description: Thin = sells under 50 credits/unit. Before the solver floor (2026-09-03): 32% thin, 280/unit, thin net -1.28M/h.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sl AS (
  SELECT l.realized_units AS u, (l.realized_unit_price - b.bpx) AS sp
    FROM tour_leg_telemetry l
    JOIN ships s ON s.player_id = $player AND s.ship_symbol = l.ship_symbol AND s.dedicated_fleet LIKE 'trade%'
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT b.realized_unit_price AS bpx FROM tour_leg_telemetry b
                   WHERE b.player_id = $player AND b.ship_symbol = l.ship_symbol AND b.good = l.good AND b.is_buy
                     AND b.realized_units > 0 AND b.realized_at < l.realized_at AND b.realized_at > l.realized_at - interval '3 hours'
                   ORDER BY b.realized_at DESC LIMIT 1) b ON true
   WHERE l.player_id = $player AND NOT l.is_buy AND l.realized_units > 0
     AND l.realized_at >= date_trunc('hour', NOW()) - interval '1 hour' AND l.realized_at < date_trunc('hour', NOW()))
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sp < 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "thin sells % (<50/u)",
       ROUND(SUM(u * sp) / NULLIF(SUM(u), 0)) AS "margin per unit",
       ROUND(SUM(u * sp) FILTER (WHERE sp < 50) / 1000.0) AS "thin net credits (k)"
  FROM sl;

SELECT balance_after AS "treasury"
  FROM transactions
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
 ORDER BY created_at DESC
 LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fleet Inventory Value (at COST)
panels.description: Cargo aboard, valued at what we paid — not market. Goods with no purchase record count 0.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
fleet_inv AS (
  SELECT g->>'symbol' AS good, SUM((g->>'units')::int) AS units
    FROM ships s CROSS JOIN me, jsonb_array_elements(s.cargo_inventory::jsonb) g
   WHERE s.player_id = me.pid AND s.cargo_units > 0
   GROUP BY 1),
cost AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
         SUM(-t.amount) / NULLIF(SUM((t.metadata->>'units')::numeric), 0) AS avg_unit_cost
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.units * COALESCE(c.avg_unit_cost, 0)), 0)::bigint AS "at cost"
  FROM fleet_inv f LEFT JOIN cost c ON c.good = f.good;

WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "trade hulls"
  FROM ships s CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE s.player_id = me.pid AND s.dedicated_fleet = 'trade';

WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS "probes"
  FROM ships s CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE s.player_id = me.pid AND s.role = 'SATELLITE';

panels.title: API Utilization %
panels.description: Share of the API rate limit in use.

panels.title: $/request (fixed 24h) - OVER-ESTIMATE
panels.description: Net profit per API request. Reads HIGH: Prometheus holds under 24h of samples, so the denominator is short (sp-ac7l). Treat as a ceiling.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)::float AS net_profit
  FROM transactions
 WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
   AND player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)

panels.title: Net P/L  [cash-flow: lags cargo in transit, not the number to steer by]
panels.description: All transactions, net, over the selected window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "net p/l"
  FROM transactions
 WHERE player_id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM players)
   AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Trade Net  [cash-flow: lags cargo in transit, not the number to steer by]
panels.description: Trading revenue minus trading costs, selected window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS "trade net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
   AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
   AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Contract Net
panels.description: Contract revenue minus sourcing costs, selected window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS "contract net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'contract'
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Net P/L per Hour by Operation  [cash-flow: lags cargo in transit, not the number to steer by]

targets.expr: avg_over_time((((sum by (operation_type)(rate(spacetraders_daemon_ledger_revenue_total{player_id="$player"}[$smooth])) or (sum by (operation_type)(rate(spacetraders_daemon_ledger_cost_total{player_id="$player"}[$smooth])) * 0)) - (sum by (operation_type)(rate(spacetraders_daemon_ledger_cost_total{player_id="$player"}[$smooth])) or (sum by (operation_type)(rate(spacetraders_daemon_ledger_revenue_total{player_id="$player"}[$smooth])) * 0))) * 3600)[30m:1m])
